about: The System One JSON contract (psionic/book/ch020-serve-systemone.md): the request {model, service_tier, state, questions}, the answer {model, answers, usage, ...} and a door's refusal {error:{code}}. One writer of the request (coax/lib/systemone/request.coax), one reader of the answer (answers.coax), one writer of our doors' refusal (refusal.coax). The bytes are the contract's documented example, request files Psionic's guard checks send (psionic/fixtures/guard-guide-requests-v1, their SHA256SUMS beside them), an answer psionic-serve printed, and what /api/v1/systemone answers for each status it refuses with. Checked by coax/lib/systemone/json-profile.coax.
